summary:
## 🌟 Summary
**Ultralytics 8.4.202 improves stream-video saving and fixes several compatibility and reliability issues, alongside updated model and benchmark documentation.**

## 📊 Key Changes
- 🎥 **Stream predictions now save at the stream’s actual frame rate.** RTSP streams, webcams, and `.streams` sources use each stream’s own FPS—including in multi-stream setups—instead of assuming 30 FPS. Video-file and screen capture rates remain unchanged.
- 🔧 **Improved model loading and export compatibility.** MNN exports now expose task metadata before loading, helping renamed pose, segmentation, classification, and OBB models—and RT-DETR exports—be identified correctly. Class-name weight remapping also works when loading CPU checkpoints into GPU models.
- ⚡ **More reliable TensorRT INT8 exports on older GPUs.** Dynamic INT8 builds on GPUs such as the T4 now use a safer minimum input size, avoiding build failures for small inputs.
- 🧰 **Clearer dataset and Platform behavior.** Classification validation now reports a helpful error when neither a `val` nor `test` split exists. Platform training arguments are sent as JSON values rather than being converted to strings.
- 📚 **Updated YOLO27 and benchmark documentation.** YOLO27 results, model details, and FLOPs reporting were corrected; benchmark scores were recalculated to account for ignored regions in VisDrone and HIT-UAV.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- ✅ Stream recordings should now play at the right speed, including when streams have different frame rates or frames are skipped.
- ✅ Model loading and deployment workflows are less likely to fail because of metadata, device, or older-GPU INT8 limitations.
- ✅ Dataset setup issues are easier to diagnose, and Platform receives more useful, correctly typed training settings.
- 📖 Updated documentation gives users more accurate performance comparisons and clearer evaluation details. These are documentation corrections, not changes to the models themselves.

## What's Changed
* docs: update YOLO27 detection, segmentation and pose results by @fcakyon in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27020
* Read MNN export metadata before loading so renamed and RT-DETR exports keep their task by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27019
* Keep class-name weight transfers on the target device by @aswanth-07 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27017
* Fix classify dataset checks and send Platform train args as JSON values by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27023
* Fix dynamic TensorRT INT8 engine builds on T4 and other SM 7.5 GPUs by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27018
* docs: update Ultralytics Benchmark scores by @fcakyon in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27022
* `ultralytics 8.4.202` Save stream prediction videos at the stream's frame rate by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27016


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.201...v8.4.202

summary:
## 🌟 Summary
**v8.4.201 makes PIL-based plotting up to 15× faster** while keeping visuals consistent, and standardizes the Construction-PPE dataset’s name and download paths. 🚀

## 📊 Key Changes
- **Faster plotting across tasks:** Training and validation mosaics and `Results.plot(pil=True)` benefit from cached fonts and label patches, fewer image conversions, and more efficient mask blending.
- **More efficient image handling:** Only plotted images are converted for mosaics, and tensor images are transferred as `uint8` to reduce overhead.
- **Construction-PPE naming and provenance updated:** Documentation and configuration now use the canonical `construction-ppe` archive and directory. The dataset is described as an original Ultralytics dataset, created and open-sourced in November 2026, with 1,000 images, 12 classes, and a CC BY 4.0 license.
- **No model architecture changes** are included in this release.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- **Quicker visual checks:** Faster plotting can reduce waiting during training, validation, and prediction review, especially when generating many annotated images.
- **Clearer dataset setup:** Consistent naming makes it easier to find and use Construction-PPE. Existing local caches using the old directory name are outside the supported scope of this release.
- **Same plotting appearance:** The optimizations target processing overhead rather than changing how annotations look. ✨

## What's Changed
* Correct Construction-PPE naming and provenance by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27015
* `ultralytics 8.4.201` Up to 15x faster PIL plotting across all tasks by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27014


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.200...v8.4.201

## 🌟 Summary
**Ultralytics 8.4.200 displays Arabic class names correctly in plots and makes training, export, and dataset workflows more reliable.** No model architecture changes are included.

## 📊 Key Changes
- 📝 **Arabic class names display correctly in plots** — Letters now join and read right-to-left in prediction, training and validation images on every install, with numbers and Latin text kept readable. No new dependency or argument is needed. This is the release’s main change.
- 🦺 **Construction-PPE dataset updated** — The new version has 1,000 images, 12 classes, and 14,863 reviewed annotations, with an 800/200 training-validation split. It adds forklift and missing-vest classes and changes class IDs. The new archive is separate from legacy downloads. [Browse the dataset on Ultralytics Platform](https://platform.ultralytics.com/ultralytics/datasets/construction-ppe).
- 🖥️ **Invalid multi-GPU batch sizes fail earlier** — Training now reports an error before distributed training starts if the batch is smaller than the number of GPUs. Batches that are not evenly divisible by the GPU count still work, with the remainder dropped.
- 📦 **Small INT8 calibration datasets are handled more reliably** — When there are fewer calibration images than the requested batch size, images are repeated to fill the batch, helping avoid export failures with some runtimes.
- 📄 **YAML directive headers are accepted** — YAML files with standard `%YAML` or `%TAG` headers can now be parsed instead of being rejected.

## 🎯 Purpose & Impact
- Arabic class names in annotated images are now legible on Windows, Linux, macOS and Docker installs where they previously showed as separate, reversed letters.
- The updated Construction-PPE dataset adds coverage for more workplace-safety scenarios, but its changed class ordering may require updates to projects that rely on the old class IDs. The legacy dataset remains available separately.
- Earlier batch-size checks and fuller INT8 calibration batches help users catch training configuration errors sooner and avoid certain export failures.
- YAML files produced by other tools are more likely to work without manual edits.

## What's Changed
* Replace Construction-PPE with reviewed Ultralytics dataset by @glenn-jocher in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27005
* Reject multi-GPU batch below the GPU count before training starts by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27006
* Parse %YAML and %TAG directive headers instead of rejecting the document by @cainiao33 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27010
* Repeat undersized INT8 calibration sets to fill the export batch by @raimbekovm in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27003
* `ultralytics 8.4.200` Display Arabic class names correctly in plots by @DrEssam97 in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27007

## New Contributors
* @DrEssam97 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/pull/27007

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics/compare/v8.4.199...v8.4.200
